CycleAnalyticInvariant (CorrectionStep.lean:9408), instantiated as ActualCyclePreservation.Invariant and held at sigma_j by state_invariant, is the Lean 'state at stage j'. Every quantitative clause of (9.7)-(9.10) appears as a named field with the paper's exponents: 1/2+sigma, 1+sigma, 1/2, 17/25 = 0.68, 9/10, 19/10, and the two exact moments; sigma_j = 1/5+j/10 is ExponentLedger.stageParameter. The structural clause that w and (beta,gamma) are curls of potentials is replaced by its divergence-free consequence, recoverable on the fixed chart; the Lean class is otherwise narrower, not weaker. findings.summary: The invariant records the divergence-free consequence rather than the paper's structural clause: no field says w is a sum of curls of wave potentials, or that (beta,v,gamma) is a curl of an azimuthal potential plus a direct azimuthal field.

Every clause is localized to the fixed chart: the two exact moments are imposed only for slow points in G.region.carrier and the class bounds only on G.strip / G.slowStrip, where the paper writes them without a domain restriction.

CycleAnalyticInvariant leaves sigma a free real, so the schedule sigma_j = 1/5 + j/10 of (9.8) is not part of the state class; it is attached only where the invariant is instantiated at the j-th iterate.
